Name: LU 139 - Zoning, 289 Kent Avenue Rezoning, Brooklyn (C 260087 ZMK).
Title:
Application number C 260087 ZMK (289 Kent Avenue Rezoning) submitted by Web Holdings LLC, pursuant to Sections 197-c and 201 of the New York City Charter for an amendment of the Zoning Map, Section
